# IMPERIA CW — Cold War: UNI 1970 decisions — decisions.
## COLDWAR | Cold War mod (MD Imperia) - The Union Plan 1970 (Soviet Union and the 14 Union republics)
## Generated by the COLDWAR Soviet generator (Claude outputs/COLDWAR_SOV_generator/cw_union.py).
## Concept: project doc claude/mdcw_union_missions_concept.md. Edit the generator, not this file.

COLDWAR_UNI_union_plan_category = {
	COLDWAR_UNI_target_civ = {
		icon = GFX_decision_generic_factory
		allowed = { COLDWAR_UNI_union_tag = yes }
		activation = { always = no }
		is_good = yes
		selectable_mission = no
		fire_only_once = no
		days_mission_timeout = COLDWAR_UNI_t_days
		available = {
			OR = {
				custom_trigger_tooltip = {
					tooltip = COLDWAR_UNI_goal_t_civ_trig_tt
					OR = {
						check_variable = { industrial_complex_total > COLDWAR_UNI_t_b1 }
					}
				}
				hidden_trigger = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_t_reported }
				hidden_trigger = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_t_ai_done }
				hidden_trigger = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_t_stormed }
			}
		}
		cancel_trigger = { NOT = { COLDWAR_UNI_is_republic = yes } }
		cancel_effect = {
			log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: Mission cancelled COLDWAR_UNI_target_civ"
			COLDWAR_UNI_clear_target = yes
		}
		complete_effect = {
			log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: Mission COLDWAR_UNI_target_civ"
			if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_t_tier = 3 } } if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_UNI_reward_industry_3 } hidden_effect = { remove_ideas = COLDWAR_UNI_reward_industry_3 } } add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_UNI_reward_industry_3 days = 180 } }
			else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_t_tier = 2 } } if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_UNI_reward_industry_2 } hidden_effect = { remove_ideas = COLDWAR_UNI_reward_industry_2 } } add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_UNI_reward_industry_2 days = 180 } }
			else = { if = { limit = { has_idea = COLDWAR_UNI_reward_industry_1 } hidden_effect = { remove_ideas = COLDWAR_UNI_reward_industry_1 } } add_timed_idea = { idea = COLDWAR_UNI_reward_industry_1 days = 180 } }
			COLDWAR_UNI_target_done = yes
		}
		timeout_effect = {
			log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: Mission timeout COLDWAR_UNI_target_civ"
			if = {
				limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_t_tolkachi NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_t_rearmed } OR = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_rearm_45 has_global_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_rearm_30 has_global_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_rearm_15 } }
				set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_t_rearmed
				if = { limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_rearm_45 } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_t_days = 45 } } }
				else_if = { limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_rearm_30 } hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_t_days = 30 } } }
				else = { hidden_effect = { set_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_t_days = 15 } } }
				custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_UNI_tolkachi_rearm_tt
				hidden_effect = { activate_mission = COLDWAR_UNI_target_civ }
			}
			else = {
				COLDWAR_UNI_target_failed = yes
			}
		}
		ai_will_do = { base = 0 }
	}

			add_manpower = -5000
			SOV = { add_manpower = 5000 }
			set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_d_komsomol
		}
		ai_will_do = {
			base = 10
		}
	}

	COLDWAR_UNI_issue_directive = {
		icon = GFX_decision_generic_political_discourse
		cost = 25
		fire_only_once = no
		target_root_trigger = { always = yes }
		targets = { UKR BLR EST LAT LIT ARM AZE GEO KAZ KYR TAJ TRK UZB MLV }
		target_non_existing = no
		target_trigger = {
			FROM = {
				COLDWAR_UNI_is_republic = yes
				NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_directive_active }
				OR = { NOT = { check_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_dir_plan = global.COLDWAR_SOV_plan } } check_variable = { COLDWAR_UNI_dir_count < 2 } }
			}
		}
		visible = {
			original_tag = SOV
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_cheap_directives }
		}
		available = {
			custom_trigger_tooltip = {
				tooltip = COLDWAR_UNI_dir_free_trig_tt
				NOT = { any_country = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_dir_pending } }
				check_variable = { global.COLDWAR_SOV_plan > 8 }
			}
		}
		complete_effect = {
			log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: Decision COLDWAR_UNI_issue_directive"
			FROM = { set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UNI_dir_pending }
			country_event = { id = COLDWAR_UNI.20 }
			custom_effect_tooltip = COLDWAR_UNI_directive_choose_tt
		}
		ai_will_do = {
			base = 0
		}
	}
